articles.title: Epic Games Boss Tim Sweeney Doubles Down on Valve Criticism, Says Steam's AI Content Disclosure Is a 'Political Act'
articles.summary: Epic Games boss Tim Sweeney spent the weekend doubling down on his severe criticism of Valve, calling Steam’s AI content disclosure a “political act.”
articles.body:
Epic Games boss Tim Sweeney spent the weekend doubling down on his severe criticism of Valve, calling Steam’s AI content disclosure a “political act.”

The controversial majority owner of Epic is all in on AI, having recently triggered a “huge pivot” of the company to retool it for “maximum AI acceleration,” Sweeney said . Epic is a long-standing rival of Gabe Newell’s Valve, with the Epic Games Store struggling to make a dent in Steam’s dominance over the PC gaming market even as it offers developers more financially beneficial terms.

Sweeney is particularly upset with Steam’s AI content disclosure policy, which requires developers to disclose the use of AI in “creating content that ships with your game, and is consumed by players.” This includes content such as artwork, sound, narrative, and localization. It does not include “efficiency gains” through the use of AI tools.

On Friday, Sweeney hit out at Valve’s policy , saying “forcing developers to write a political statement to be used against them by the hate mob they’re helping organize is abhorrent.” This statement sparked a backlash online, with a number of people — developers included — confused by the suggestion that an AI disclosure was political in any way, and insisting that Valve was only providing clarity its customers wanted.

“Customers have a right to know what they’re buying,” David Goldfarb, founder of Metal Hellsinger developer The Outsiders and former Battlefield developer, replied. “They still bought Arc Raiders, they will definitely buy games they want to buy, AI use or no. Does it disadvantage small teams who need to leverage AI to survive? Jury’s out. Calling it a hate mob is far-fetched.”

Undeterred, Sweeney issued a number of social media posts defending his position, saying AI disclosures are “just as partisan as mandatory political essays or forcing developers to list their voting history to drive cancel campaigns and public struggle sessions.”

When one person challenged Sweeney on this, accusing him of being "anti-consumer" for forcing something consumers don't like on them, the Fortnite boss compared Steam's AI disclosures to Valve forcing developers to list their political affiliations.

"Say there is a large contingent of gamers that don’t like democrats or, equivalently, republicans. Should Valve force developers to list their political affiliation? Is that pro-consumer? Do you think that policy would have a positive effect on gaming?" he said . As you can imagine, this statement was ridiculed in the replies, with one person saying "equating AI to how a person votes is pure cope gymnastics."

Again, undeterred, Sweeney claimed that Valve is hitting developer revenue by “undermining their business with these AI hate campaigns,” insisting on “a real economic cost to Valve’s foray into forced political disclosures.”

He continued : “a substantial number of users would love to have mandatory political opinion disclosures for developers, with several saying they take it upon themselves to surface this info in reviews since it’s not disclosed on product pages.

“The primary use of both categories of disclosures is to drive cancel campaigns against games and deprive them of revenue and livelihood unless they get onboard with the movement’s political goals. Yes, blocking free choice to adopt productive technology is a political act.”

Earlier this month, Epic revealed a newly refreshed version of the Epic Games Launcher , its Steam-like platform that provides access to the Epic Games Store, your games library, social features, and a developer’s hub. And, in keeping with the company’s push for AI-assisted development , this new version of the launcher was created using generative artificial intelligence. “Programming is hard,” wrote Epic in a new blog post . “So, instead of doing that, we vibe coded a new Epic Games Launcher that’s way faster and more responsive than the current one, and has a new look.”

Epic then launched an Unreal Engine vibe coding contest with an image of a six-fingered hand, presumably as a joke about poor quality AI images.

Vibe your way to 50K. The 2026 Epic AI MegaJam begins Nov 12: — Unreal Engine (@UnrealEngine) October 22, 2026

Vibe your way to 50K. The 2026 Epic AI MegaJam begins Nov 12:

Through it all, Valve has done what it does best: remain quiet. The long-running joke that Gabe Newell simply sits back and waits for his competitors to make mistakes seems particularly relevant here, as Tim Sweeney continues to tweet his outrage over Valve and Steam. Meanwhile, earlier this month Steam broke its all-time record for concurrent users yet again, with 43.5 million people logged in at the same time.

Photographer: SeongJoon Cho/Bloomberg via Getty Images

articles.title: GTA 6 tampoco se perdió el Clásico: El Camp Nou, otra pieza clave en la estrategia de Rockstar Games
articles.standfirst: El videojuego estuvo presente en la victoria del Real Madrid ante el FC Barcelona
articles.summary: El videojuego estuvo presente en la victoria del Real Madrid ante el FC Barcelona
articles.body: Ayer vivimos uno de los momentos clave de la temporada futbolera y deportiva en general y es que un nuevo Clásico llegaba a nuestras vidas. FC Barcelona y Real Madrid se volvían a ver las caras en un duelo en el que los de Hansi Flick llegaban como claros favoritos, por las sensaciones de inicio de temporada y por ser locales. Pero el Real Madrid sorprendió a todos en el Camp Nou sacando una muy meritoria victoria en un momento en el que pocos confiaban en los de Mourinho. Más allá de lo meramente futbolístico, todos sabemos lo que genera un partido de esta magnitud. Millones de personas en todo el mundo están pendientes de lo que ocurre durante esos 90 minutos. Pues bien, Rockstar Games también es plenamente consciente de la expectación que genera un Clásico y por eso convirtió este acontecimiento en una pieza más de su estrategia. Y es que durante las últimas semanas estamos viendo cómo la compañía está llevado a cabo una estrategia de marketing para promocionar el GTA 6 que va más allá de la publicidad en web, redes sociales o las típicas plataformas, ya que está llegando a las ciudades más importantes del mundo para dejar su huella. Más que conocido es todo el movimiento que está generando Rockstar en Miami, ciudad en la que está basado el GTA 6, donde los coches del videojuego están llegando a las calles y la ciudad en general se está transformando en el juego. Además, por ejemplo, hemos visto un cartel gigante en París con la imagen del juego, pero esto no acaba aquí. El Clásico también se convirtió en uno de esos puntos claves de Rockstar para promocionar la salida del GTA 6 el próximo 19 de noviembre. Y es que durante el encuentro vimos la publicidad del videojuego en los carteles de pie de campo, dejando una imagen que pasará a la historia y que confirma que Rockstar está llevando su estrategia a otro nivel, 'conquistando' los lugares más importantes en el momento preciso.

images.caption: Mbappé, el 'rey' de un Clásico que no se perdió el GTA 6

articles.title: Red weather warning issued for Isle of Man coastal overtopping
articles.summary: The rare red weather warning for waves crashing onto coastal roads means extreme conditions with a risk to life.
articles.body:
A red weather warning has been issued for the Isle of Man for large waves crashing onto coastal roads.

It is in place for coastal overtopping from 22:00 until 01:00 GMT on Tuesday.

A red warning is rare and means extreme conditions are likely, with a risk to life, as well as possible widespread damage, travel disruption and interruptions to power and communications.

The government has asked people to take the "warning seriously and avoid affected coastal areas."

Coastal overtopping or wave overtopping is the amount of water that is discharged by waves over a structure such as a breakwater.

When the waves break, it causes water to flow onto the land with debris.

Alongside the red warning, an amber one for inner harbor flooding has been issued by forecasters at Ronaldsway Met Office.

"Inner harbour flooding expected around the time of the high tide tonight, with a storm surge in the Irish Sea," it said.

The banks of River Sulby to Gardener's Lane.

The Met Office said flood defences should also be deployed for the lowest-lying parts of Castletown Harbour.

In addition, a yellow warning for severe gales will come into force from 18:00 until 06:00 on Tuesday.

Gusts between 50-60 mph (80-96 km/h) are expected widely with up to 65mph (104 km/h) forecast for higher ground exposed coastal areas.

"This may result in fallen branches/ trees and disruption to travel," forecasters said.

The Liverpool crossing, which was scheduled for 15:00, left Douglas Harbour earlier at 06:00.

While both Manannan Larne sailings were cancelled.

At Ronaldsway Airport, all scheduled flights are going ahead as planned however, the airport have asked for passengers to arrive two hours early due to the number of disrupted flights taking off today.

Over the weekend, Storm Boelo kept teams from the Department of Infrastrucutre busy.

The DOI said crews dealt with 85 fallen trees, 31 flooding incidents, and more than 25 other storm-related call-outs.

Sailings and flights to and from the island were also cancelled.

articles.title: EA Sports FC 27 dicta sentencia: este será el ganador del Balón de Oro 2026
articles.standfirst: Este será el futbolista que se lleve el galardón según el popular videojuego
articles.summary: Este será el futbolista que se lleve el galardón según el popular videojuego
articles.body: Ha llegado uno de los momentos más esperados del año en el mundo del fútbol: conocer quién será el próximo ganador del Balón de Oro. Con varios candidatos que han firmado una temporada sobresaliente, la batalla por hacerse con el prestigioso galardón promete estar más igualada que nunca. A priori, los tres grandes favoritos para levantar el Balón de Oro 2026 son Lamine Yamal, Harry Kane y Kylian Mbappé. Los tres futbolistas han protagonizado una campaña en la que han demostrado su enorme calidad y capacidad para marcar diferencias sobre el terreno de juego. Sin embargo, ¿quién se llevará finalmente el premio? Desde MARCA Gaming hemos querido resolver esta incógnita de una manera muy especial. Para ello, hemos simulado el Modo Carrera de EA Sports FC 27 hasta conocer al ganador del Balón de Oro. Y, aunque esperábamos que la decisión estuviera entre los tres grandes candidatos, el videojuego ya ha dictado sentencia y ha elegido a su propio favorito. Con EA Sports FC 27 ya disponible, desde MARCA Gaming hemos aprovechado la ocasión para comprobar qué futbolista termina imponiéndose en la carrera por el Balón de Oro según el nuevo videojuego de fútbol de Electronic Arts. Para descubrirlo, hemos recurrido al Modo Carrera y hemos avanzado en la simulación hasta conocer el nombre del jugador que consigue hacerse con el galardón en esta edición. Una prueba que nos permite comprobar cómo interpreta el título la evolución de las grandes estrellas del fútbol mundial y quién termina ocupando el primer puesto entre los mejores jugadores del planeta. Y el elegido por EA Sports FC 27 no es otro que Lamine Yamal. El joven futbolista del FC Barcelona se impone en la simulación y se convierte en el ganador del Balón de Oro 2026 según el videojuego. Una elección que, sin duda, le sitúa como uno de los grandes protagonistas de esta particular predicción virtual. El resultado no resulta del todo descabellado. Lamine Yamal se ha consolidado como una de las grandes figuras del fútbol mundial y su talento le permite competir de tú a tú con jugadores de la talla de Harry Kane y Kylian Mbappé. Su capacidad para desequilibrar partidos, generar ocasiones y convertirse en un futbolista decisivo le ha colocado entre los nombres más destacados de la actualidad. Eso sí, que FC 27 haya elegido a Lamine Yamal no significa que el español vaya a ganar necesariamente el Balón de Oro en la realidad. La simulación del videojuego es simplemente una predicción virtual y no tiene por qué coincidir con la decisión final de los votantes.

articles.title: Heroes Never Die, a Survivor-Plus-Tactics Strategy Game, Announced for PC
articles.summary: If you've ever wondered what a fusion of Vampire Survivors and Heroes of Might and Magic would look like, then Heroes Never Die might be the game for you. It's a newly announced fantasy strategy game from developer Ludogram that "aims to take the best of the survival formula and fuse it with more tactical decisions, real-time army building, and powerful fantasy heroes." It will be released in 2027 for PC.
articles.body:
If you've ever wondered what a fusion of Vampire Survivors and Heroes of Might and Magic would look like, then Heroes Never Die might be the game for you. It's a newly announced fantasy strategy game from developer Ludogram that "aims to take the best of the survival formula and fuse it with more tactical decisions, real-time army building, and powerful fantasy heroes." It will be released in 2027 for PC.

In Heroes Never Die, you'll choose your titular hero – there are over 20 in the lineup – and battle not just monster hordes but also rival heroes. Each hero has their own skills, but no matter who you pick, you'll seek to upgrade your town by gathering resources and fighting foes. There are also four factions and over 60 different units, with the developers promising that no two runs will be alike.

“We’re delighted to finally announce Heroes Never Die, a project we’ve been working on in the shadows for a couple of years”, said creative director Edouard Gaudel. “We cannot wait to see our first players fighting hordes of monsters, and evolving their armies while meeting our heroes. Don’t forget to join our upcoming Playtest!”

If you're interested, you can sign up for the private playtest and/or wishlist Heroes Never Die on Steam .

Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
